ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, a promoter of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, has disclosed a minor open market acquisition of 53,351 shares, representing 0.02% of the target company's total voting capital. This increases their total promoter holding from 33.61% to 33.63%. The acquisition is a routine regulatory disclosure under SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers Regulations, with no material impact on company control or any discernible red flags given the acquirer's existing significant promoter status.
